artworks.title: Battle of the Lapiths and Centaurs
artworks.description: The centauromachy on the metopes of the Parthenon — Peirithous' wedding turned to war, the canonical image of Lapiths and centaurs locked in stone combat that Pausanias' pediment descriptions echo in Athens.

artworks.title: The Battle of the Lapiths and the Centaurs
artworks.description: Rubens' tumultuous Baroque panel — wine, women, and horse-men in a whirl of flesh and fury, the wedding feast of Ovid and Homer painted for the Torre de la Parada.
